$comment: Generated by website-builder from a live crawl. Categories and section names are heuristics (see meta.generatedBy); edit this file, then re-run `node validate.mjs && node build.mjs`.

meta.generatedBy: website-builder: section names come from the page's own markup (data attributes, React component names, ids, classes, landmarks); categories are keyword heuristics

categories.CONTENT: The substantive body of a page: articles, listings, resources and general sections.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block: the main headline (h1) and first call to action.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation: capabilities, benefits, workflows and integrations.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, testimonials, reviews and case studies.
categories.CTA: Conversion prompts: sign-up, demo, newsletter and get-started bands.
categories.SUPPORT: Questions and contact: FAQs, help, forms.
categories.SHELL: Site chrome: navigation, header, footer, announcement bars and other elements carried across pages.
